cancellation_guides.settings_location: Netflix App / Web > Account > Membership & Billing (or netflix.com/cancelplan)
cancellation_steps: Sign in to your Netflix account in a web browser or the Netflix app.
Click your profile icon in the top right corner and select 'Account'.
Under the 'Membership & Billing' section, click the 'Cancel Membership' button (or go to netflix.com/cancelplan).
Click 'Finish Cancellation' to confirm. Your access will continue until the end of your current billing period.
cancellation_guides.checked_source_title: Netflix Help Center - How to cancel or pause your Netflix account
mandate_guidance: If you signed up with UPI AutoPay, you must separately revoke the recurring mandate in your UPI app (Google Pay, PhonePe, or Paytm).
Open your UPI app > Profile > 'AutoPay' / 'Recurring Payments' > Select 'Netflix' > Tap 'Revoke Mandate' or 'Pause'.
Enter your UPI PIN to permanently revoke the payment authority so future charges cannot be debited.

cancellation_guides.settings_location: Spotify Web > Account Overview (spotify.com/account) > Your Plan
cancellation_steps: Log in to your account page at spotify.com/account in a web browser (direct plans cannot be cancelled in-app).
Under 'Your plan', click 'Change plan'.
Scroll down to 'Cancel Spotify' and click 'Cancel Premium'.
Confirm the cancellation. You will retain Premium features until your next billing date.
cancellation_guides.checked_source_title: Spotify Support - How to cancel Premium plans
mandate_guidance: Cancelling Spotify Premium stops Spotify from requesting renewals, but for UPI AutoPay (or recurring card mandates), revoke the mandate directly:
Go to your UPI App (e.g. PhonePe / Google Pay / BHIM) > Manage AutoPay / E-mandates.
Locate 'Spotify India / Spotify AB' and tap 'Cancel Mandate' / 'Revoke'. Confirm with your UPI PIN.

cancellation_guides.settings_location: Amazon.in App / Web > Your Account > Prime > Manage Membership
cancellation_steps: Go to Amazon.in and navigate to 'Your Account'.
Click on 'Prime - View benefits and payment settings'.
Click on 'Manage Membership' in the menu bar.
Select 'End Membership and benefits' and follow the on-screen prompts to confirm cancellation.
cancellation_guides.checked_source_title: Amazon.in Help - End Your Amazon Prime Membership
mandate_guidance: For annual or monthly Prime e-mandates issued on debit/credit cards or UPI:
Visit your bank's NetBanking portal > E-Mandate Hub or SI Management.
Or check Google Pay / PhonePe > AutoPay > 'Amazon Pay India' > Revoke AutoPay mandate.

cancellation_guides.settings_location: Disney+ Hotstar App / Web > My Space > Help & Settings > Subscriptions
cancellation_steps: Open the Disney+ Hotstar app or visit hotstar.com/in.
Go to 'My Space' or your Profile icon.
Select 'Help & Settings' and click 'Subscriptions'.
Select 'Cancel Membership' and complete the verification step.
cancellation_guides.checked_source_title: Disney+ Hotstar Help - How do I cancel my subscription?
mandate_guidance: If subscribed via Google Play / Apple App Store, cancel directly in the Play Store / iOS Subscriptions settings.
If set up via direct UPI AutoPay (Novi Digital), open your UPI app (Paytm/PhonePe/GPay), navigate to AutoPay, select Novi Digital / Hotstar, and revoke the mandate.

cancellation_guides.settings_location: YouTube Web / App > Profile > Purchases and memberships (youtube.com/paid_memberships)
cancellation_steps: Open youtube.com/paid_memberships or the YouTube mobile app.
Tap your profile picture and tap 'Purchases and memberships'.
Tap on the membership you want to cancel (YouTube Premium).
Tap 'Deactivate' or 'Manage', then select 'Continue to cancel' and select a reason.
cancellation_guides.checked_source_title: YouTube Help - Cancel your YouTube paid membership
mandate_guidance: YouTube Premium mandates are managed through Google Pay / Google Payments profile at payments.google.com.
Go to payments.google.com > 'Subscriptions and services' > Cancel.
To prevent future charges, also check your banking app / UPI AutoPay settings and revoke Google India / Google Payments mandates.

cancellation_guides.settings_location: Google One Web (one.google.com) / App > Settings > Cancel membership
cancellation_steps: Go to one.google.com on your browser or open the Google One Android/iOS app.
Click the 'Settings' icon (gear) on the left sidebar.
Click 'Cancel membership'.
Confirm by selecting 'Cancel membership' on the prompt. Note: Storage shrinks to free 15 GB upon expiration.
cancellation_guides.checked_source_title: Google One Help - Cancel your Google One membership
mandate_guidance: Open Google Play Store > Tap Profile Icon > 'Payments & Subscriptions' > 'Subscriptions'.
Select Google One and tap 'Cancel Subscription'.
Check your UPI app (PhonePe/GPay/Paytm) under AutoPay and delete the active e-mandate.

cancellation_steps: Open the 'Settings' app on your iPhone or iPad.
Tap your Apple Account name at the very top.
Tap 'Subscriptions'.
Tap the subscription (e.g. iCloud+, Apple Music, Apple One) and tap 'Cancel Subscription'.
cancellation_guides.checked_source_title: Apple Support - If you want to cancel a subscription from Apple
mandate_guidance: Apple requires Apple Account funds or an RBI-compliant e-mandate for recurring Indian billing.
To stop future debits at the banking layer, log in to your bank's net banking portal > 'Standing Instructions / E-Mandates' > Revoke mandate for Apple Services India.

cancellation_steps: Go to account.microsoft.com/services and sign in with your Microsoft account.
Find your Microsoft 365 subscription and select 'Manage'.
On the next page, select 'Cancel subscription' (or 'Upgrade or Cancel').
Follow the instructions on the page to proceed with cancellation.
cancellation_guides.checked_source_title: Microsoft Support - Cancel a Microsoft 365 subscription
mandate_guidance: For annual card e-mandates or recurring bank debits, cancel recurring billing at account.microsoft.com first.
If charged through recurring debit cards, use your bank's SI Hub portal to remove the Microsoft e-mandate.

cancellation_guides.settings_location: Merchant Official App/Web > Profile > Settings > Subscriptions
cancellation_steps: Log into the merchant's official web portal or mobile application directly.
Navigate to Account / Profile > Settings > Subscriptions, Billing, or Payments.
Look for an option labelled 'Cancel Subscription', 'Turn Off Auto-Renew', or 'Manage Plan'.
Ensure you receive a confirmation email or SMS acknowledging the cancellation.
cancellation_guides.audit_note: No dedicated official web cancellation URL exists. General legal terms page (swiggy.com/terms-and-conditions) does not provide direct cancellation steps. Actionable cancellation is in-app only and via UPI AutoPay mandate revocation.
mandate_guidance: In Indian banking, cancelling an in-app subscription does NOT always revoke the bank-level standing mandate.
Open your UPI Application (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, CRED).
Go to Settings / Profile > 'AutoPay' / 'Recurring Payments' / 'E-mandates'.
Locate the merchant name or VPA, tap 'Revoke Mandate' or 'Cancel', and enter your UPI PIN to stop future debits.
For debit/credit card e-mandates, log into your issuing bank's NetBanking portal and visit the 'SI Hub / E-Mandate Management' section to cancel.
